_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
goal.description: How to End your Randomized playthrough.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

description: Whether or not to include checks for the Reversed versions of each level.
NOTE: Golden Melon and Secret Melon checks in Reverse levels are named identically to their Forward counterparts.
Any Impossible Golden / Secret Melons, and Shortcuts that do not work, in the Reverse version of a level are removed from that Reverse level's locations.
Whether or not to include checks for collecting Secret Melons.
Adds 308 checks - 597 if Reverse levels are enabled.
Whether or not to include checks for collecting Golden Melons.
Adds 153 checks - 300 if Reverse levels are enabled.
Whether or not to include checks for collecting each of the credits in Desert 6.
Adds 11 checks - 22 if Reverse levels are enabled; will only work if Golden Melons are also enabled.
Whether or not to include checks for taking the developer-intended shortcuts found in a handful of levels.
Adds 14 checks - 21 if Reverse levels are also enabled.
How many Level Packs (each consisting of 3 sets of levels) must be completed in order to complete the game.
